name: Shadow Touched
summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha; Invisibility and a level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell, each free once per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Shadow Magic
benefits.summary: Invisibility and a level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell are always prepared; each is free once per Long Rest.
benefits.text: Choose one level 1 spell from the Illusion or Necromancy school. You always have that spell and Invisibility prepared. You can cast each of them once without a spell slot, regaining the free casting of each when you finish a Long Rest, and you can also cast them using spell slots of the appropriate level. Their spellcasting ability is the ability you increased with this feat.
